subject: general
question: In 2024, India celebrated its first National Space Day. What event did this day commemorate?

options.text: The successful landing of Chandrayaan-3 on the Moon
The launch of India's first satellite, Aryabhata
The establishment of the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)
The launch of India's first manned space mission

solution:
The correct answer is __**The successful landing of Chandrayaan-3 on the Moon**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• India celebrated its first National Space Day in 2024 to commemorate the **historic landing of Chandrayaan-3** on the Moon.
 
• **Chandrayaan-3** successfully landed on the lunar surface on **August 23, 2023**, making India the first country to land a spacecraft near the Moon's south pole.
 
• The mission was a significant milestone for the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) and demonstrated India's growing capabilities in space exploration.
